title: Notice of Adverse Benefit Determination
paragraphs: We reviewed the claim submitted by Lantern Hill Cardiology under your Medicare Advantage plan for services provided on June 27, 2026. After review, we are unable to approve payment.
This claim was denied because the provider who performed the service is out-of-network for your plan. Reason code: CO-242.
The plan paid $0.00 of the $2,084.34 billed. The amount you may owe the provider is $2,084.34.

appeal.heading: Your Right to Appeal
appeal.text: You or your authorized representative may file a written appeal within 180 days of the date you receive this notice. Send it to Hollis Creek Health, Appeals Unit, PO Box 29876, Houston, TX 77002. If waiting for a standard decision could seriously harm your health, you may ask for an expedited appeal by calling 1-800-555-5030.
appeal.external: After the internal appeal, you may have the right to an independent external review. Free help is available from your state's consumer assistance program.
